item.redstonecircuit.redstone_goggles.ti: Worn on the head: blocks holding redstone become translucent and show what is inside
You can see the shape, facing, delay and wiring of the redstone inside a block
The redstone wrench needs them to be worn
item.redstonecircuit.superconducting_red: Like redstone: right-click to lay it on a block, shift-right-click to put it inside one
No signal loss: it carries its full strength however far it goes
item.redstonecircuit.redstone_wrench.tip: Right-click redstone to pick it as A
Shift-right-click a neighbour B (a piston, a lamp, any block - it needs no redstone of its own) to lock that line and cut every other side; repeat to step through lock / cut / auto
item.redstonecircuit.rotation_rod.tip.in: Right-click a block holding redstone: its input side turns to the face you clicked
item.redstonecircuit.rotation_rod.tip.ou: Click the same face again: its output side turns there; once more cycles back
item.redstonecircuit.rotation_rod.tip.wi: Dust has no direction, so the rod has nothing to turn
